entries.title: Ask HN: Cheapest/easiest way to host a static site?
entries.author: offtop5
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Cheapest/easiest way to host a static site?

entries.title: Ask HN: Do you think Agile/Scrum is beneficial for software delivery?
entries.author: andyxor
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Do you think Agile/Scrum is beneficial for software delivery?
entries.excerpt: what are the pros and cons of sprints and daily standups in your experience Coming from old school 'non-agile' financial world focused on bottom line I was in a bit of a shock learning about this daily standup ritual. Besides being a dream for micromanagers, it seems to be more about signalling progress vs. actually making progress. Do these extra bureaucracy layers, meetings, checkmarks and vague "man-points" estimates actually bring any value.
entries.guide_zh: 冲刺迭代和每日站会究竟有无帮助，征集敏捷与 Scrum 的实际使用体验。

entries.title: Ask HN: What are some “10x” software product innovations you have experienced?
entries.author: pramodbiligiri
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are some “10x” software product innovations you have experienced?
entries.excerpt: Peter Thiel has written about the "10x rule" for startups, where your innovation has to be 10 times better than the second best option [1]. Have you personally experienced such 10x improvements in your own interactions with software? What were they? [1] - https://thenextweb.com/entrepreneur/2015/07/13/the-10x-rule-for-great-startup-ideas/
entries.guide_zh: 你用过哪些带来数量级改善的软件创新，明显超越原有解决方式？

entries.title: Ask HN: What was the biggest contributor to your happiness in the past year?

entries.title: Launch HN: Remora (YC W21) – Carbon capture for semi trucks
entries.author: paulgross
entries.current_title: Launch HN: Remora (YC W21) – Carbon capture for semi trucks
entries.excerpt: Hi HN! I'm Paul, one of the co-founders of Remora ( https://remoracarbon.com ). Remora is building a device that captures the carbon emissions from a semi truck. Our device mounts between the truck and its trailer, attaches to its tailpipes, and captures at least 80% of its carbon emissions. We will sell the captured carbon dioxide to concrete producers and other end users, helping companies earn new revenue while meeting their climate commitments. We decided to start Remora
entries.guide_zh: Remora 团队展示面向半挂卡车的碳捕集设备，尝试降低运输排放。
